import pandas as pd
import csv
import io

# Read input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Get unique indicator_ids in sorted order
indicator_ids = sorted(df['indicator_id'].unique())

# Pivot to wide format: one row per city_id/year, one column per indicator_id
pivot = df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Ensure all indicator columns are present (in sorted order)
pivot = pivot.reindex(columns=indicator_ids)

# Extract city_name for each city_id/year combination
city_name_map = df.groupby(['city_id', 'year'])['city_name'].first().reset_index()
city_name_map.columns = ['city_id', 'year', 'city_name']

# Merge city_name with pivot table
result = pivot.join(city_name_map[['city_id', 'year', 'city_name']], on=['city_id', 'year'])

# Fill missing values with empty string
result = result.fillna('')

# Reorder columns: city_id, city_name, year, then indicator_ids
output_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + indicator_ids

# Create final dataframe
output_df = result[output_columns]
